notes.title: Songs of Skydale v0.8.0.0
notes.content:
It took like forever to make this update but it's finally ready.

Here are the changes:

- Added new environmental art
- Added two new parts to the main quest
- Added four new quests: Whitemarsh Bandits, Whitemarsh Dungeon, Beer Business and Insanity
- Added four new enemies: frost wasp, enemy soldier, sorcerer boss and spirit boss
- Added bandits camps that can be raided
- Added three new items
- Added fire traps
- Added a separate collision box for the player's sword --> sword hits are now much more accurate than before
- Finished Whitemarsh as a geographical region
- Fixed minor bugs
- Improved enemies path finding
- Removed some of the invisible walls
- Reworked lots of old tree textures
- Reworked some old animations

notes.title: Songs of Skydale v0.7.5.7
notes.content:
The next big update is coming up nicely, but I decided to release a small update before it. 
  
- Added a minor side mission to main quest (it will make the starting of the game little bit easier for new players)
- Fixed minor bugs
- Improved enemies' hit boxes (enemies will not take damage so easily if they are positioned behind the player's character during a fight)

tags.feature: - Added a minor side mission to main quest (it will make the starting of the game little bit easier for new players)

tags.balance_change: - Improved enemies' hit boxes (enemies will not take damage so easily if they are positioned behind the player's character during a fight)

notes.title: Songs of Skydale v0.7.5.6
notes.content:
- Added new environmental art
- Added glow effect for mushrooms
- Added possibility to remap controls
- Changed default controls
- Fixed minor bugs
- Improved HUD
- Improved enemy movement
- Improved fireball's hit boxes

Also, here is a mini roadmap for the next two updates:

- The first update will focus completely on new locations, quests and items. 
- The second update will add a prologue for the game. The idea behind the prologue is to make the game 
   more approachable for new players.

- Adjusted blocking skill: 20 --> 30

- Improved starting and ending of snow effect
- When playing with normal difficulty, the player starts with three health and mana potions instead of none
